comment: Capability matrix (improvements list item 8). The runner consults this BEFORE signup: a task whose routed template is disabled is skipped (journaled as skipped-capability) to protect reputation. Each template lists keyword patterns (case-insensitive, regex) matched against title+description. 'enabled: false' means the template exists but the agent cannot honestly execute it unattended right now (e.g. social follow/join needs real accounts).

download.note: Downloads the artifact referenced in the description, computes sha256, writes signed attestation + proof.json.

social.note: Would record a signed 'followed X on DATE' statement + optional screenshot. DISABLED: no social accounts controlled by the agent (Discord access confirmed unavailable).

research.note: Fetches sources from the description (curl), produces a sourced report + signed hash.

content.note: Writes provided/generated content to a deliverable file + signed hash.

monitoring.note: M2 path: reuse existing alert_hash + sign flow.

skip_globally.comment: Any task whose title/description/verification contains one of these is skipped outright (regardless of template), because the verification method is outside anything we can produce (heavy design/creative/branding).
